detection.description: The system's brain detects new models, creations, formulas, systems, etc., by matching. The system is tied into the copyright and patent systems. Once the brain detects a match, it clearly makes the formula mathematically and issues a Formula Comptrix record.
detection.herWords: Mathematical computations to formula. My system is tied into the copy right patent systems.. my system detects new models and creations formulas systems etc.. by matching brain of six nacis patent dms etc. Now.. once my systems brain detects it.. it clearly makes the formula mathematically.
detection.matching: Matching is by declared, inspectable signals against the brain's known records — shared name/term overlap and shared formula structure. The match score is one stated computation: M = t + 2s, where t is the number of shared terms and s is the number of shared formula-structure terms; a match is declared at M >= 2. No hidden scores, no invented machine learning — a faithful reference implementation of her design.
detection.onDetection: Detection -> formula -> record: the computation is rendered as the formula, mathematically, and the record is issued with her fields in her order.

federal_integrations_note: Designed integration points, spec only in this pass — no live API calls. Each is read/match via the agency's official public interface, on agency terms.
industry: Industry — her clarification (2026-10-20): every Formula Comptrix record is classified by industry.
placeInSystem: One living, breathing system: Formula Comptrix is the brain's detection-and-record machinery inside Goddess Myriad AI.io. It stands beside BlockSeal — BlockSeal seals her own works at creation; Formula Comptrix watches the copyright and patent field, detects what matches, and puts the detection on record. Both are provenance machinery: authorship, date, and industry, provable by record.

purpose.aggregation: Because every record is dated and industry-tagged, the records aggregate — counted by industry and by year — into industry telemetry: an honest, mechanical count of what the brain has detected, where, and when.
purpose.forecast: Forecast also (her addition): trendByIndustry compares, per industry, the count in the earlier half of the dated record window against the later half and labels the trajectory rising / steady / declining. It is a forecast computed from the documented record and labelled forecast, not fact — her Truth Standard: only proven information is stated as fact.
purpose.gauges: The aggregate is used to gauge economics and GDP movement, to identify new industries rising and industries phasing out, and the information feeds future builds for industry technology.
purpose.herWords: This too will help future builds for industry technology the information is used to gauge economics gdp and new industry and phased out industries
